group_label: Extra missions (Nadesico B, Ra Cailum, White Fang...)

glossary.role: Computer voice prefix (alarm messages in katakana-robot speech).
Militant anti-Earth colony organization, later led by Zechs Merquise
Londo Bell flagship battleship (Bright Noa's ship) in CCA.

glossary.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing / Endless Waltz

glossary.role: The alien Grados Empire, from the Udoria system, that invades and occupies Earth in Layzner. Adjective form: Gradosian.

glossary.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing / Endless Waltz
glossary.role: Ace pilot (Tallgeese, Tallgeese III); former OZ officer and White Fang leader; Preventer agent ('Preventer Wind') in Endless Waltz. True identity Milliardo Peacecraft, Relena's older brother.
glossary.personality: Proud, chivalrous and self-loathing; a brilliant pilot torn between knightly ideals and soldiering. Speaks with formal dignity.

glossary.note: Op 01 uses 'unit' for mecha in general, 'machine' when the speaker is the developer
